narrative.overview: The page is one board the visitor scrolls along. Sections are components placed on a soldermask ground, copper is the single committed accent, and measured values are set in mono like silkscreen. Depth comes from hairline borders and tonal steps between greens, never from glow.
keyCharacteristics: Dark green-black ground, off-white text, one copper accent, tin-silver as the only secondary line color.
Flat at rest; borders carry structure.
Mono type only for measured values and designators.
Copper trace motifs appear as hero background and under every section h2.
Motion is reveal-up and trace-fill, all disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The One Copper Rule
rules.body: Copper is the only accent. It marks action, selection, and progress; it is never a large fill other than a button or selected tab.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: No neon, no text gradients. The only radial wash is a faint copper tint behind the contact section.

rules.name: The Measured Values Rule
rules.body: Mono is for things that are measured or identified (dates, DOI, index numbers, readouts, designators). Prose and headings never use it.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure comes from a 1px Trace Line border, not from shadow or fill. Shadow is reserved for loose objects (polaroid, ID card).

dos: Do use copper (#d08a52) only for action, selection, progress, and designators.
Do build structure from 1px Trace Line borders and tonal steps between the greens.
Do set measured values (dates, DOI, indices, readouts) in JetBrains Mono.
Do keep touch targets at 44px and keep the 2px copper focus ring.
Do gate reveals, marquees, scope animation and trace fill behind prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add glow, neon, or gradient text; the page refuses the generic dark portfolio.
Don't use a second accent hue; tin-silver is a line color, never a fill.
Don't put drop shadows on cards; shadow is only for the loose polaroid and ID card.
Don't set prose or headings in mono.
